limits.scope: C-shim modular partial correctness under the public contract, fixed ISA configuration and explicit intrinsic-spec boundary

domain.dimensions: uint64 values bounded only by explicit valid nonwrapping input/zero/weights/params/output footprints; positive H/W/channels, top0..1,0<=start<end with2*(end-1)+1-top<H. No arbitrary32bit or finite/ordered-float restriction.
domain.read_alias: Single shared RO map permits complete/partial input, supplied zero-row, packed weights and params aliases; zero row arbitrary fp32 values.
domain.output: Standard nonoverlapping logical CHW windows with stride gaps and arbitrary initial Some/None outside/written state. Internal clipped last-row and last-channel padded-lane3 aliases retained by actual store order. General overlapping logical CHW windows not claimed.
domain.fp: All binary32 values incl q/sNaN,Inf,±0,subnormal and unordered bounds. RNE; default-NaN/flush modes/traps disabled, flags unobserved.
domain.rvv: Fixed VLEN128/e32m1/VLMAX4/XLEN64, all legal VL choices0..4 at spec; active loop positive, inactive data arbitrary.
domain.observation: Internal full binary32 model and ordinary helper bit-structural identities; cross-ISA dw_rel permits differing NaN payloads, public dw_observe is numerical fp32_eq or both NaN, hence does not require NaN payload or signed-zero bit identity. Neither is an all-ISA execution refinement.

RVV.legal_VL_choices: all choices permitted by the reviewed hc_rvv_vl contract; no fixed chosen VL restriction

limits.float_domain: all binary32 values, including signaling/quiet NaNs, infinities, signed zeros, subnormals and unordered clamp bounds
limits.floating_environment: RNE; default-NaN/flush/traps disabled; exception flags unobserved
limits.observation: Public numeric fp32 equality or both NaN, entire optional output state and exact unwritten frame; no NaN-payload or signed-zero-bit equivalence claim
limits.arithmetic_order: Each accumulator preserves original27 fused operations and operand order; no reassociation. Left absence performs+0*weight; right absence skips the whole corresponding group; supplied vertical zero row is arbitrary data.
limits.memory: Full/partial aliases among readonly input, supplied zero row, packed weights and params allowed. Mutable output owner and standard separated logical CHW windows follow the public predicates; clipped last row/channel aliases preserve physical store order. Logical inactive one-past cursors may equal2^64; actual active addresses and casts obey original public bounds.

actual_C_goal_identity_preflight: Must be archived as preparation only; full run regenerates each actual goal independently
